beforeChangeAfter.before: Browser helper fetch/body/retries had no total deadline. Silent connection or JSON body left the section loading indefinitely.
beforeChangeAfter.change: LeagueClient supplies optional absolute monotonic intent deadline to existing helper; one budget spans response, body, retries and backoff. Timeout aborts and reports existing unavailable state. Final monotonic check refuses late JSON completion even if timer task was delayed.
beforeChangeAfter.afterLocal: 57 focused tests pass and independent corrected review approves. No deployed before/after usefulness measurement in this record.
beforeChangeAfter.verdict: Local bounded-failure correctness correction, not normal-speed acceptance.

semantics.lifecycle: First-document marker committed only in effect. StrictMode replay preserves pending section work; real unmount aborts. Inactive pending sections still populate their own cache; expired late bytes cannot publish.

limitations: No production5second guarantee or useful-speed improvement established. Delayed hydration, event-loop blocking and dynamic component loading can still exceed the deadline; immediate honest fallback cannot undo elapsed time.
Synchronous parsing cannot be preempted; late completion is rejected before helper returns.
Client abort does not establish cancellation of backend worker/provider work.
Root cause of the unfinished activity response may involve upstream computation, cache, database, network or proxy; no causal claim is selected.
React component tests mock navigation and section renderers; actual production/SSR/SPA validation remains required.
Unavailable is a truthful failure outcome, not numerical or normal-speed success.
No independent totals are summed with overlapping author tests.
